title: Promote release candidate metadata
outOfScope: Publishing a tag or public release asset
Changing release workflow implementation, signing, branch protection, SBOM/provenance generators, or runtime security
Deleting historical release or Work Item evidence

sources.reason: Current published release projection that must be promoted to the next source-bound release identity.
Candidate release projection v0.5.43 and previous-release relationship.
Canonical release lifecycle and metadata digest state.
Provider workflow requires release.json.releaseTag to equal the requested immutable tag.
WI-18 process issue and corrective Work Item record.
Required Contract, verification, PR, archive, branch-cleanup, and base-sync lifecycle.

riskAssessment.reason: Incorrect promotion could make a provider release identify the wrong version or source; metadata must be derived from the candidate and exact synchronized main commit.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized serial corrective Work Items and required process defects to be corrected before the release proceeds.

preReviewWarnings: Verify candidate-to-published projection, exact source/archive/installer digests, previous-release relationship, and that no provider publication occurs in this corrective Work Item.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: release.json is promoted from the v0.5.42 published projection to the v0.5.43 source-bound release projection using next-release.json as the candidate authority.
release.json releaseArchive assetName, URL, SHA-256, installerDigest, capability status, and supply-chain fields are source-bound and internally consistent.
release-state.json and release-digests.json distinguish the new candidate/published projection from historical v0.5.42 and preserve previousRelease semantics.
finalize-release-freeze and check-release-preflight pass on the exact synchronized main source without publishing a tag or asset in this corrective Work Item.
The complete corrective lifecycle passes: Contract, preflight, verification, Summary, PR, CI, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch cleanup, and origin/main synchronization.
guidelines: Release metadata must be source-bound and machine-readable.
Candidate, historical, and published release states must not be conflated.
This corrective Work Item must not publish externally.

intent.problem: WI-18's provider workflow requires release.json.releaseTag to equal the requested tag, but the merged release Work Item left release.json at v0.5.42 while next-release.json declares v0.5.43. Publication must stop until the candidate projection is promoted through a governed corrective Work Item.
constraints: Use the latest synchronized origin/main as the base.
Promote only from next-release.json and preserve v0.5.42 historical identity.
Do not create an immutable tag or public release asset in this corrective Work Item.
Run the full PR/merge/close/branch-cleanup lifecycle before the final release flow resumes.
intent.rationale: The release workflow must consume one coherent source-bound published projection; correcting the projection before provider publication prevents a version identity mismatch.

rawUserRequest: 继续执行用户已授权的全面整改计划。WI-18 发布前发现 release.json 仍是 v0.5.42、next-release.json 才是 v0.5.43，导致 provider release workflow 会 fail closed。请先修复这个流程/元数据投影问题，完成独立 corrective Work Item 的完整 Contract、验证、PR、CI、合并、关闭、清理分支和同步 main 生命周期；不得绕过发布门禁或在 corrective Work Item 中直接发布。

declaredIntent.summary: Promote the release candidate projection into coherent source-bound release metadata without external publication.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Candidate v0.5.43 and published v0.5.42 metadata are distinct and previousRelease is preserved.
Release archive, installer, and metadata digests are regenerated for the exact synchronized main source.
A corrective change cannot publish a tag or public asset.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User authorized corrective process Work Items before release; external publication remains explicitly out of scope here.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
